verdict.rationale: Meltano documents dbt as its transformation layer and says `meltano run` executes EL(T) pipelines that include workflows like dbt. This suggests transformations run inside the same pipeline as extraction and loading, rather than on a separate timer. However, no evidence explicitly shows dbt being sequenced to run after a load completes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of chaining dbt steps after extractor/loader steps in a single run, dependency or trigger semantics that guarantee transforms only run on freshly loaded data, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, dbt transformations run against freshly loaded data as part of the pipeline, not on a blind timer

citations.quote: Transformations in Meltano are implemented using dbt.
You can run EL(T) pipelines using [`meltano run`]
Run all pipelines in one place, across databases, files, SaaS tools, internal systems, and workflows like dbt.
